title: Refreshed data set for the training environment

articles.subject: Refreshed data set for the training environment
articles.body:
Hello,

We are training the regional offices in week 40 and the training environment still holds data from February. We would like a refreshed copy, with personal data replaced, so that the exercises use realistic case types.

Is that something you can prepare before the end of September?

Best regards,
Håkan Nyberg
Programme director, Regionalt Utvecklingsverket
